title: Metro Opens
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-16 from story_script_v1 §5 (2.2), ADR-05/ADR-115, game_components §4/§6. The user edits the words and the numbers; then P11 builds it.
time: A weekday morning, the first sleep after 2.1's scooter decision
player_goal: Ride the Purple Line on opening day.
design_goal: Reveal #13: the metro network (ADR-05 world event). Progress: the map grows from one bus route to a line. Reward: the first ride is free. The three Whitefield metro challenges start the station-unlock ladder (game_components §6) that 2.4 IKEA cashes in at Majestic.

cast.role: Gate attendant in a high-vis vest. Opening-day line: 'Free today, sir. Tomorrow you pay like everyone.' Explains tokens vs the gate; points at the jammed machine.
Six, Spider-Man T-shirt, crying by the pillar. Challenge #1 'Lost kid': walk him to the guard or find his mother in the crowd (she is by the token machine) → lost_kid_returned, +rep.
In the token queue, has not noticed yet. Takes the kid back; 'Thank you, thank you' in Kannada and English.
Feeding a torn ₹10 note into the token machine for the fourth time. Challenge #2 'Token machine jam': tell him it is free today / press cancel for him / lend him ₹10 → token_jam_fixed.
An old woman standing with a cloth bag on the train. Challenge #3 'Seat for elderly': stand up (give seat, +rep) or keep sitting (an aunty's remark, −rep) → seat_given / seat_kept.
Citizens from the shared sheets: a selfie group under the flags, a man filming the first train, a family with a garland. Atmosphere only.

beats.what: The morning after the scooter decision: a News headline 'Purple Line: Whitefield stretch opens today, rides free till midnight' and Sameer's chat ('Metro finally! Go before the crowd. Free today.'). Step onto the Whitefield street: the blue sheets and the caged pillar are gone; a finished station mouth with stairs, bunting in orange-white-green, inauguration flags on the poles, a crowd on the pavement.

Up the stairs into the station concourse (new pocket, compressed like the bus): token counter, two token machines, the AFC gates, a Purple Line strip map on the wall, the platform beyond. The guard at the gates: free today, tokens from tomorrow (₹10 + ₹2/km, ADR-115).

Challenge #1, the lost kid by the pillar. Walk him to the guard (safe) or spot his mother in the token queue (warmer; she reads 'Spider-Man' off your line). Either way he goes home; the second route gives more rep.
beats.interact: dialogue + companion walk (reuse the Ananya 'companion' behaviour for the kid)

beats.what: Challenge #2, the token machine jam. The uncle keeps feeding a torn note. Options: 'It is free today, uncle' (he will not believe you until the guard waves) / press cancel for him (note comes back) / lend ₹10 (he insists on UPI-ing it back, which he never does). All three clear the queue.

Through the gates, onto the first train: a Purple Line coach (new interior, on the bus pattern), 30 s ride that pauses while you talk, 'Next station: Cubbon Park' on the strip. You get the last seat. Challenge #3: the ajji with the cloth bag stops in front of you. Stand up (seat_given, +rep, she blesses you) or keep sitting (seat_kept, −rep, an aunty two seats down says 'Youngsters' loud enough).

'Cubbon Park. Doors open on the left.' Fade — the park, from the station side this time. Toast: 'Purple Line ridden'. Maps: the Purple Line fills in, the five famous stations (Whitefield · KR Puram · Indiranagar · MG Road · Cubbon Park) show as rings; METRO · ₹N appears between visited pockets that sit on stations (ADR-115, already built, fare ₹0 today).

After midnight the fare applies: ₹10 + ₹2/km in ₹5 steps, cap ₹60 (Whitefield ↔ Cubbon Park ≈ ₹50). Two of the three challenges done → metro_tier 1 (the ladder 2.4 IKEA needs for Majestic). The scooter cannot enter the station (parking zone at the stairs; 'No two-wheelers beyond this point').

economy.trigger: metro ride, after opening day (₹10 + ₹2/km, ₹5 steps, cap ₹60)

exits.note: on metro_interior; the bus pattern (ride: {seconds: 30, exit, flag, label})

open_questions: WHEN does the line open? Draft: the first sleep after scooter_decided (so the event lands whether or not you bought the scooter). Alternative: the second salary day.

WHICH new pocket? Draft: none beyond the station concourse and the coach — the free first ride lands at the existing Cubbon Park (from its station side), MG Road opens with 2.3 Guitar (Church Street), Indiranagar when a beat needs it. Alternative: Indiranagar 100 Ft as the opening-day destination (one more pocket, one more session).
FARE after day one: tokens at the ADR-115 fare (₹10 + ₹2/km, ₹5 steps, ₹60 cap) — keep? A Namma Metro card (₹50, the 'metro card' sink in game_components §7) as a later convenience (2.4) or now?
CHALLENGES: all three in 2.2 (draft) or #3 only on the train and the concourse pair later? What does metro_tier 1 unlock — draft: Majestic becomes ridable for 2.4 IKEA (Green Line).
The COACH: its own district on the bus pattern, 30 s (draft) — or 20 s like the bus?
REP numbers for the seat check: draft +2 / −2 on the Whitefield district standing (ReputationManager); the kid's mother route +3, the guard route +1.
The story script contradicts itself (§3 says the metro opens in 2.3, §5 says 2.2) — draft takes 2.2.
Does Ananya text about the metro (she is met in 1.6 in the built game, the character sheet says 2.2)? Draft: Sameer only; Ananya's chat comes in 2.3.
